zh: 修正「供款3年，6年後每年拿4萬」將等待期當成供款年期的計算問題。供款年期、等待期與領取年期獨立；年供/月供均在指定供款期結束後停止，餘額繼續按假設回報增長。保單演示入口亦保留真實供款年數。
已識別的未來領取條件可點擊直接修改；供款年期超過等待期、非整數、零年或衝突條件會要求更正。未明示供款年期時，會清楚列出沿用等待期供款的假設，避免把推測當成已知。
補強英文句序：即使供款條件放在等待期之後，也不會把「供3年」誤填為「領3年」，或覆蓋明示的領取年期；沒有說要領幾年時仍需補充。
分享流程分離圖片與PDF：「海報＋分析書」改為全部PNG，分析書PDF單獨匯出，不再產生PNG/PDF混合分享。長報告提供完整頁碼批次選擇，每批最多9張以減少記憶體使用，不代表任何接收應用的官方上限。
核心海報按內容自然決定高度，不再強制1080×1920；預覽與匯出使用同一內容，短結果不留大空白，長標籤、摘要與關鍵輸入不靠裁切隱藏。PDF分析書維持固定頁面。
分享取消不再顯示成功提示；其他狀態只提示已交给系統分享／下載，不把系統接收當成微信或收件人已收到。新增原句、獨立現金流公式、分享格式、完整分批、大字手機、自然高度與實際圖像/PDF回歸。
en: Separated funding years, payout delay and payout duration. A three-year contribution term with a six-year delay now stops contributions after year three for both annual and monthly funding, while invested assets continue growing. The insurance simulator handoff preserves the funding term.

Recognized income-plan conditions can be edited directly. Invalid or conflicting funding terms require correction, and unspecified funding terms are explicitly identified as assumptions rather than recognized facts.
English contribution clauses after the future date no longer fill an unspecified payout duration or overwrite an explicit one. Missing payout years still require confirmation.

Split image sharing from PDF export. Poster-plus-report sharing now contains PNG images only; PDF is exported separately. Long reports expose every page through batches of up to nine images to manage memory, not as a claimed receiving-app limit.

Core posters now have content-driven height instead of a fixed 1080-by-1920 canvas. Preview and export use the same complete content; key labels, summaries and inputs wrap naturally. Analysis PDFs remain paginated.

Dismissed shares no longer show a success message; other results report system handoff rather than asserting delivery to WeChat or a recipient. Added original-phrase, independent cash-flow, format-boundary, complete-batch, large-text, adaptive-layout and actual image/PDF regressions.
